title: Privacy Policy
content:
This policy explains what personal information Gangotri Expeditions collects when you use this website or book a yatra with us, why we collect it, and what you can ask us to do with it.

What we collect

We only collect what we need to answer your enquiry and run your trip:

  • Contact details - name, phone number, email address, submitted through our enquiry form, WhatsApp, or over the phone.
  • Trip details - preferred dates, group size, budget range and any requirements you tell us about.
  • Identity documents - a photo ID, required by the Uttarakhand government for Char Dham registration and permits.
  • Usage data - anonymous analytics about which pages are visited, collected through Google Analytics.

How we use it

  • To reply to your enquiry with an itinerary and a price.
  • To book hotels, vehicles, permits and helicopter slots in your name.
  • To file the Char Dham registration and Yatra e-pass required by law.
  • To contact you about your booking before and during the trip.

We do not sell your information, and we do not add you to a marketing list unless you ask us to.

Who we share it with

Only the parties needed to deliver your trip: hotels and camps, transport operators, helicopter operators, and the Uttarakhand Tourism Development Board for registration. Each receives the minimum required, and nothing beyond that.

How long we keep it

Enquiry records are kept for two years. Booking and payment records are kept for seven years, as required for tax and accounting. Identity documents are deleted once the trip is complete and the permits have expired.

Cookies

This site uses cookies for analytics only. There are no advertising or tracking cookies. You can block cookies in your browser settings, and the site will continue to work normally.

Your rights

You can ask us for a copy of the information we hold about you, ask us to correct anything wrong, or ask us to delete it where we are not required to keep it. Email and we will respond within 30 days.

title: Terms & Conditions
content:
These terms apply to every booking made with Gangotri Expeditions. By paying an advance you confirm that you have read them and that everyone in your group accepts them.

Booking and payment

  • A booking is confirmed only once the advance of 25 percent has been received and we have sent you a written confirmation.
  • The balance is due seven days before departure. We may treat a booking as cancelled if the balance is not paid by then.
  • Prices are per person on twin sharing unless the itinerary says otherwise, and are quoted in Indian Rupees.

Prices and changes

Quoted prices hold for the dates confirmed in writing. Government-set charges such as permits, helicopter fares and pony rates are outside our control and are billed at actuals. If a government levy or fuel cost changes materially before departure, we will tell you the revised figure and you may cancel without penalty if you do not accept it.

Your responsibilities

  • Carry valid photo identification for every traveller, including children.
  • Declare any medical condition, pregnancy, or medication that could be affected by altitude, before booking.
  • Follow the instructions of the trek leader or guide on the route. They have final authority on whether the group proceeds.
  • Arrange your own travel insurance. We strongly recommend a policy that explicitly covers high-altitude trekking.

Our responsibilities

We will provide the services listed under inclusions on your itinerary, using operators we have checked. Where a listed hotel or camp is unavailable, we will substitute accommodation of a similar or better standard and tell you in advance.

Changes and cancellation by us

Mountain conditions decide a great deal. We may change a route, reorder days, or call off a departure for weather, landslides, road closures, government order or any situation that puts the group at risk. In those cases the cancellation policy applies. Safety decisions taken on the ground by the trek leader are final and are not grounds for a refund.

Limits of liability

We are not liable for delay, loss or injury caused by events outside our reasonable control, including weather, natural disaster, road blockage, strike, accident, or the act of a third-party operator such as an airline or helicopter service. Our liability in any case is limited to the amount you have paid us for the trip.

Photography

We may photograph groups during a trip and use those images in our marketing. Tell your guide, or email us, if you would prefer not to appear, and we will exclude you.

Governing law

These terms are governed by the laws of India. Any dispute is subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Dehradun, Uttarakhand.

title: Cancellation & Refund Policy
content:
Plans change, and mountains change them more often than most places. This page sets out exactly what you get back, and when.

If you cancel

Cancellation takes effect from the date we receive your request in writing, by email or WhatsApp. The charge is calculated on the total trip cost.

Cancellation charges by notice period
Notice before departure Cancellation charge You receive
More than 30 daysBank transfer charges onlyFull advance refunded
30 to 15 days25% of trip cost75% refunded
14 to 7 days50% of trip cost50% refunded
Less than 7 days100% of trip costNo refund
No-show on departure day100% of trip costNo refund

Helicopter tickets, train and air fares, and government permits are non-refundable once issued, whatever the notice period. Those amounts are deducted before the table above is applied, and we will show you the receipts.

If we cancel

We call off departures for weather, landslides, road closures, government order, or anything else that makes the route unsafe. In those cases you may choose either:

  • Transfer - move to any other departure in the same season at no extra charge, or
  • Refund - receive everything back except costs already paid out and not recoverable from hotels, transport and helicopter operators.

We will always show you what those non-recoverable costs were. In practice they are small when we cancel more than a week out, and larger when a road closes mid-trip.

Trips cut short

If a trip is abandoned after it has started - a road closes behind you, or the group is turned back at a barrier - there is no refund for the days already completed. We will refund unused hotel nights where the property returns the money to us, and we will get you back to the pickup city at no extra cost.

Leaving the group early

If you choose to leave a trip once it has begun, for any reason including altitude sickness or a personal emergency, unused services are not refundable. We will arrange transport down and assistance getting home; those costs are yours.

Changing your dates

A date change more than 30 days before departure is free, subject to availability. Inside 30 days it is treated as a cancellation and a new booking.

How refunds are paid

Refunds go back to the account the payment came from, within 7 to 10 working days of the cancellation being confirmed. We do not issue cash refunds.

Contact

To cancel or change a booking, write to or message . Please include your booking reference and the departure date.
